Observed /catalog lists only vati_synthetic v2026110301; app logs show catalog=None, 'Indexed 5 entities' and no requests to data/delivery.opensanctions.

Observed via python3 scripts/yente_dev.py smoke: alias 'SBR Trading' -> top result vati-syn-co-border-retail score 1.000 match=true; 'Synthetic Highland Imports' -> two ambiguous candidates vati-syn-co-highland-imports 0.943 and vati-syn-co-highland-import-services 0.880 (both match=true) from dataset vati_synthetic version 2026110301; unrelated name no matches; /match/opensanctions 404; /updatez without token 403; healthz/readyz 200. tests/tooling/test_yente_dev.py 6 tests OK; dev.py check and quality.py passed.

Tests and evidence recorded for criteria 1-2; task.py finish refreshed from origin/main, reran dev.py check and quality.py (Node 24.20.0), pushed task/TAX-027, opened human-review PR https://github.com/Vati-AI/rsl-taxathon/pull/99 and synced issue #28 to IN_REVIEW. Not merged by the agent.
